faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: 1. How do I use the Daily Quote feature?
faq.a1: Simply open the app and tap on the "Daily Check-in" card on the home screen. Select your current mood and what you need (e.g., Motivation, Peace), and Novus will generate a personalized quote just for you.
faq.q2: 2. How do I save a favorite?
faq.a2: When viewing any quote, tap the "Heart" icon to save it to your Favorites. You can access all your saved quotes from the "Favorites" tab in the bottom navigation bar.
faq.q3: 3. How do I report a bug or send feedback?
faq.a3: We value your feedback! Please email us directly at support@pointtwostudios.com with a description of the issue or your suggestion.

about.title: About Novus
about.text: Novus is a personalized mental wellness companion designed to help you track your mood and find daily inspiration. Built with a privacy-first approach, all your data stays securely on your device. Whether you need motivation, peace, or just a moment of reflection, Novus is here to support your journey.
